**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether increasing x makes this classifier more cautious beyond support; recall x−10 is equally far outside support and predictsMinus near1.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Move query1→10/0/−10 recomputes logits, probability, support distance and declared heldout correctness; retain in-support and high-confidence-wrong witnesses. Show the support interval separately from probability, not a “certainty” badge.
